name: design-gate
description: Checks a built UI against its design mock (Figma, image, PDF, HTML or claude.ai artifact) in every aspect: missing screens, sections, controls and features, content, states, layout and visual tokens. It also gates changes for AI design slop (the mock and design tokens are the allow-list), keeps the gap report current when the mock changes, and drafts designer questions. Gap checklists are written for Sonnet subagents to work through cold, and each gap is re-checked. A hook reminds you to re-check after UI edits to files a report names.
